d: Sanju Samson knows how quickly things can change in Indian cricket. Not long ago, he was fighting to get back into the playing XI. After his performances at the T20 World Cup, he is now making room for 15-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi at the top of the order. Samson's decision in the ongoing IND V NZ T20Is when Ishan Kishan got injured says a lot about what happens away from the spotlight. Rupha Ramani looks at the story behind Sanju Samson's selfless call and the lesson it offers India's next generation.
